cards.ex: She got choked up when talking about her late husband.
cards.exUz: U marhum eri haqida gapirganda bo'g'ilib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: His-tuyg'ular kuchayib, gapirishga qiynalish; tomog'iga nimadir tiqilgandek bo'lish.

cards.ex: Give him a few minutes to simmer down before you talk to him.
cards.exUz: U bilan gaplashishdan oldin unga tinchlanishi uchun bir necha daqiqa bering.
cards.uzDef: Jahli yoki xavotiri pasaymoq, tinch holatga qaytmoq.

cards.ex: I was beside myself with worry when she didn't come home last night.
cards.exUz: U kecha uyga kelmaganida, men xavotirdan o'zimni yo'qotib qo'ydim.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand, hayajonda yoki g'azabda o'zini nazorat qila olmaslik.

cards.ex: My knee-jerk reaction was to say no, but I need to think about it.
cards.exUz: Mening shoshilinch reaksiyam yo'q deyish edi, lekin men bu haqda o'ylab ko'rishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'ylamasdan, avtomatik tarzda berilgan javob yoki reaksiya.

cards.ex: We were bitterly disappointed by the election results.
cards.exUz: Saylov natijalaridan qattiq hafsalamiz pir bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta umidlar puchga chiqqani sababli chuqur norozilik hissi.

cards.ex: I think you're jumping the gun by planning the wedding already.
cards.exUz: O'ylaymanki, to'yni allaqachon rejalashtirib, shoshilinch qaror qabul qilyapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Vaqti kelmasdan oldin biror ishni qilishga shoshilish.

cards.ex: She was in inconsolable grief after her dog died.
cards.exUz: Iti o'lganidan keyin u taskin topmas qayg'uda edi.
cards.uzDef: Shunday chuqur qayg'uki, uni hech qanday yo'l bilan yengillashtirib bo'lmaydi.

cards.ex: The thought of public speaking is stomach-churning for me.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy nutq so'zlash fikri men uchun ko'ngil aynishiga sabab bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qo'rqinchli yoki jirkanchli bo'lganligi sababli ko'ngil aynishini keltirib chiqaradigan.

cards.ex: I felt a surge of emotion when I saw him again after all these years.
cards.exUz: Yillar o'tib, uni yana ko'rganimda hissiyotlar to'lqinini his qildim.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan paydo bo'ladigan kuchli hissiyotlar.

cards.ex: The government is trying to keep a lid on the protests.
cards.exUz: Hukumat noroziliklarni nazorat qilib turishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning chiqib ketishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik, nazoratda ushlab turish.

cards.ex: The support we received was beyond words.
cards.exUz: Biz olgan yordam ta'riflab bo'lmas edi.
cards.uzDef: Shunchalik kuchliki, so'z bilan ifodalab bo'lmaydi.

cards.ex: They're going through a rough patch in their marriage.
cards.exUz: Ularning nikohida qiyin davr bo'lyapti.
cards.uzDef: Hayotda qiyin vaqt, muammolar ko'p bo'lgan davr.

cards.ex: He was seething with anger after the meeting.
cards.exUz: U yig'ilishdan keyin g'azabga to'lgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Ichida juda kuchli g'azabni his qilish, ammo tashqariga chiqarmaslik.

cards.ex: Humor is often used as a coping mechanism in stressful situations.
cards.exUz: Hazil ko'pincha stressli vaziyatlarda moslashuv usuli sifatida ishlatiladi.
cards.uzDef: Stress yoki qiyinchilik bilan kurashish uchun ishlatiladigan usul.

cards.ex: I'm torn between staying and leaving.
cards.exUz: Men qolish va ketish o'rtasida ikkilanaman.
cards.uzDef: Ikki qaror orasida tanlashda qiynalish, o'zini ikkilangan his qilish.

cards.ex: I felt a wave of nostalgia when I saw my old school.
cards.exUz: Eski maktabimni ko'rganimda sog'inch to'lqinini his qildim.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishga bo'lgan kuchli sog'inch hissi.

cards.ex: It took him a long time to come to terms with his father's death.
cards.exUz: Otasi vafotini qabul qilish uchun unga ko'p vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror noxush narsani qabul qilish va unga moslashish.

cards.ex: I had a sense of dread before the exam.
cards.exUz: Imtihon oldidan menda vahima hissi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda yomon narsa bo'lishini kutishdan kelib chiqadigan qo'rquv hissi.

cards.ex: She was brimming with joy at the news of her engagement.
cards.exUz: U unashtirilganligi haqidagi xabardan quvonchga to'lgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand va baxtiyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: I had to grit my teeth and get through it.
cards.exUz: Men tishimni g'ijirlatib, uni yengib o'tishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilikni sabr bilan yengish, g'azab yoki og'riqni yashirish.

cards.ex: We were on tenterhooks waiting for the test results.
cards.exUz: Biz test natijalarini kutib, xavotirda edik.
cards.uzDef: Xavotirda yoki noaniqlikda bo'lish, natijani kutish.

cards.ex: He stared at her in utter disbelief.
cards.exUz: U unga mutlaq ishonchsizlik bilan qaradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga mutlaqo ishonmaslik, uni qabul qila olmaslik.

cards.ex: Talking to her really helped me put things in perspective.
cards.exUz: U bilan gaplashish menga vaziyatga real qarashga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Narsalarga to'g'ri nuqtai nazardan qarashga yordam berish, ularning ahamiyatini baholash.

cards.ex: He sank into utter despair after losing his job.
cards.exUz: U ishidan ayrilganidan keyin butunlay umidsizlikka tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday umid qolmagan holat, ruhiy tushkunlik.

cards.ex: I breathed a sigh of relief when I heard he was safe.
cards.exUz: Uning xavfsizligini eshitganimda yengil tortdim.
cards.uzDef: Xavf yoki tashvish o'tib ketganidan keyin yengillik his qilish.

cards.ex: She was in a state of shock after the accident.
cards.exUz: U avtohalokatdan keyin shok holatida edi.
cards.uzDef: Katta voqeadan keyin his-tuyg'ularini boshqara olmaslik holati.

cards.ex: I think I hit a nerve when I mentioned his divorce.
cards.exUz: O'ylaymanki, men uning ajrashishini tilga olganimda, achchiq haqiqatni aytgan bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining o'ziga tegadigan, nozik nuqtasiga tegib ketish.

cards.ex: I saw a flash of anger in his eyes.
cards.exUz: Men uning ko'zlarida g'azab chaqnashi ni ko'rdim.
cards.uzDef: To'satdan paydo bo'ladigan kuchli g'azab hissi.

cards.ex: He didn't bat an eye when I told him the news.
cards.exUz: Men unga yangilikni aytganimda u ko'zini ham qirmadi.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyot bildirmaslik, hayron qolmaslik yoki xavotirlanmaslik.

cards.ex: I'm at the end of my tether with these kids!
cards.exUz: Men bu bolalar bilan sabrim tugadi!
cards.uzDef: Sabri tugagan, chidami qolmagan holat.
